title: Affine fpqc coverings admit finite standard refinements
statement: Let $T=\operatorname{Spec}(R)$ be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme], and let $\{f_i:T_i\to T\}_{i\in I}$ be an fpqc covering [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering]. Then there are a finite set $J$, indices $a:J\to I$, and affine opens $V_j\subset T_{a(j)}$ such that each $V_j=\operatorname{Spec}(A_j)$ and the induced ring map $R\to\prod_{j\in J}A_j$ is faithfully flat [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map].

source.place: Definition Tag 022B (topologies-definition-fpqc-covering), together with the affine refinement used in Descent Lemma Tag 03N0

proof.text: Form the PreZeroHypercover of the given family. The qc part of hf gives QuasiCompactCover; apply Mathlib QuasiCompactCover.exists_isAffineOpen_of_isCompact to the compact whole affine base. This gives finite selected affine opens with union of images equal to the whole base. The other part of hf gives Flat for each family morphism.

source.place: Definition Tag 022B (topologies-definition-fpqc-covering), affine-open condition with U = T

proof.text: Restrict each flat family morphism to the selected affine open. Scheme.Hom.flat_appTop gives flatness of its global-section map; compose with the bijective ΓSpecIso inverse. Regard these coordinate rings as R-algebras. Transport flatness of their direct sum along DirectSum.linearEquivFunOnFintype to obtain flatness of the finite product.

source.place: Lemma Tag 01U5 (lemma-flat-characterize), clause (1) implies (2); finite-product flatness as in Algebra, Tags 00HB and 00DD

proof.text: For a prime p of R use the covering equality to find a selected affine open and a point mapping to p. Its isoSpec image is a prime q of its coordinate ring. Naturality of toSpecΓ and the ΓSpecIso counit identity show that q contracts to p. Pull q back along the product coordinate evaluation map; comap_comp_apply shows this prime also contracts to p. Apply RingHom.FaithfullyFlat.iff_flat_and_comap_surjective.

source.place: Lemma Tag 00HQ (lemma-ff-rings), equivalence of faithful flatness with surjectivity on spectra for a flat map; covering images from Topologies Definition Tag 022B
